svg.title: Matching AGVs to root tray moves
svg.desc: DoAgvAssignments builds an AGV-by-TrayMove cost table for the current root events and runs BottleneckAssignment; infeasible pairs get no edge.
svg.metadata: ["One outer iteration of DoAgvAssignments: the root TrayMoves are e4 (T15 -> P19) and e1 (T21 -> P23); the candidate AGVs are A, B and C. The cost table is still empty.", "GetAgvToTrayAssignmentCost(A, e4): A drives from W26 to T15 on P15 and lifts it, about 41 s.", "A -> e1: A drives to T21 in bay B21, about 48 s.", "B -> e4: B at W18 is close to P15, about 19 s, the cheapest pair.", "B -> e1: B drives to B21, about 36 s.", "AGV C already carries T24, so the cost function returns nullopt for both moves and C gets no edge.", "BottleneckAssignment minimises the largest cost used. With only edges <= 19 s (B-e4) it can match one move, not two.", "Raise the limit to 36 s: B-e4 and B-e1 both need B, so still only one move can be matched.", "At 41 s, A-e4 joins and {A-e4, B-e1} matches both moves; the threshold is 41 s. The cheaper total {B-e4 19 s, A-e1 48 s} loses because its worst pair is 48 s.", "The matching goes to GetEventDag(), which orders matched AGVs whose paths would collide; then each pair is expanded into AGV events."]
